# Format v2 literal oracles

Each `.hex` file is one binary artifact written as lowercase hexadecimal with
whitespace ignored. Empty row files represent zero-byte values. All integers,
field ordering and hash coverage follow FORMAT.md. These are fixed expected
bytes, never regenerated by the code under test. Development calculation used
Python `struct.pack` and `hashlib.sha256`; neither is a runtime/build dependency.

Retained artifacts describe application rows and operation/import preimages.
SQLite owns physical database/WAL formats; retired custom-container fixtures
are removed. Blob 0x44 has length 3 and the SHA-256 of ASCII `abc`.

## Row fixtures

The Rust test constructs expected typed fields independently and compares
literal bytes both ways. Shared IDs: mailbox 0x55, thread 0x66, email 0x77,
identity 0x88, notification email 0x99, attempt 0xaa, device 0xbb.
`row-import-*` uses a synthetic digest of 32 bytes 0xcc; it pins field placement,
not a claimed source preimage. SMTP receipts contain two explicit aliases,
IPv4 direct and IPv6 admitted gateway provenance, with negative receivedAt.
Mailbox fixtures cover optional parent and role. Submission fixtures cover
initial and completed/notified state. Recipient fixtures cover unattempted
and uncertain state with retained RCPT response. Four relationship values
are empty. Lease covers both permitted uses.

The row/operation codecs consume these artifacts for exact field encodings
and truncation/corruption checks. Portable provider tests hash blob `abc` and
independent import snapshot preimages; they make no custom-container claim.

## Import source preimage oracles

Mailbox: name Projects, parent source ID parent-1, no role, sortOrder 1,
subscribed true. Email: raw abc, length 3, receivedAt -1, source mailbox
IDs aa and z, keywords $seen and project. Sorting is by raw IDs, so aa
precedes z even though its length prefix compares after z.

Mailbox preimage hex:

```text
010800000050726f6a656374730108000000706172656e742d31000100000001
```

SHA-256: `2ebfa0d8f9aaecd36e1288487ab8419eeba45d7e22cbb079f6f5ea1a53a2cb05`.
